item.title: Carville doubles down on urging Ilhan Omar to leave the Democratic party after she blasted White males
item.description: Veteran strategist James Carville suggested Rep. Ilhan Omar leave the Democratic party and join the Democratic Socialists after criticizing her attacks on White males as electorally destructive.

item.title: Katie Couric asks Gavin Newsom if being 'ridiculously good-looking' is a problem
item.description: Katie Couric asked Gov. Gavin Newsom if he has a problem with being too "ridiculously good-looking" during a podcast interview, prompting online backlash.

item.title: Jayson Tatum, 10 months after Achilles injury, expected to return to Celtics Friday vs Mavericks: report
item.description: Jayson Tatum could finally return to the Boston Celtics' lineup Friday against the Dallas Mavericks, which would be just 10 months since his Achilles injury.

item.title: Private flights account for 30% of departures from Oman airport as wealthy evacuate Middle East
item.description: Private flights account for more than 30% of departures from Oman's main airport as Middle East evacuation efforts intensify amid conflict escalation.

item.title: Trump criticizes modern MLB during White House event: 'They do things wrong'
item.description: President Donald Trump criticized MLB during Inter Miami CF's White House visit, saying baseball isn't as hot as it used to be, and they do "things wrong" with the sport.

item.title: Legendary former Packers President and CEO Bob Harlan dead at 89
item.description: Former Green Bay Packers President Bob Harlan, who transformed the franchise back into Super Bowl champions, died at 89 after leading the team for nearly two decades.

item.title: Russell Wilson escalates feud with Sean Payton, labels Broncos coach 'classless'
item.description: Russell Wilson called Sean Payton "classless" and referenced the bounty hunting scandal in response to the Denver Broncos coach's comments about a quarterback change.

item.title: Rep. Tony Gonzales announces he will not seek re-election amid House Ethics investigation into affair
item.description: Rep. Tony Gonzales of Texas announces he won't seek re-election after admitting to extramarital affair with former staffer amid growing controversy.
